item.description:

In this introductory workshop, you’ll learn how to upload a variety of sources, analyze dense scholarly articles, and chat directly with your research using the exact source citations to eliminate hallucinations. Plus, we’ll explore the Studio to turn your “notebook project” into: study guides, detailed reports, beautiful slides, infographics, videos; or aggregate, extract data and identify key findings from your uploaded sources. item.title: Mapping the Election: The Impact of Historic and Modern Maps on the Midterms NEW — Wed Oct 28, 6:15 PM — Montclair Bellevue Ave Branch - Kids Place
item.description:
This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
All eyes are on the midterm elections, and maps--both old and new--not only show how people vote but often help set and reinforce the patterns of how citizens are divided. First we'll take a look at maps of gerrymandering, which started in Massachusetts in 1811 and have taken very specific forms in the United States because of the rules of the American political system. We'll move onto the familiar red and blue election maps and examine how they privilege big, sparsely populated states like Wyoming over dense locations like New Jersey. We'll also take quick looks at great historical images, like Civil War-era election maps whose sectional splits look shockingly modern.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: Kill Goofy — Sun Oct 11, 1:30 PM — Grove Street Theater
item.description:
Apricot Sky Productions’s new play, Kill Goofy by Livingston playwright Eric Alter, opens October 9 and plays for three weekends throught October 25. The story is simple on the surface. Two best friends, inseparable at thirteen, haven’t spoken in thirty years. One of them never left his childhood bedroom. His mother never left because someone had to take care of him. Then the other one comes back to town, and everyone in that house has been keeping the same secret. It’s a play about the things we never say to the people closest to us, and it sends people out the door talking. Please note the play deals with difficult subject matter and is recommended for ages 15 and up. The full synopsis and content advisory plus more information are at https://apricotskyproductions.com/killgoofy. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Oct 21, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream
